clauses.earlier_end_tests: Own terms: withdrawal 'in aid of legislation proposed in pending H. R. Rill 12319' states no end date or condition (own text, sha f9950c1f...); no held source shows H.R. 12319 enacted or lapsed, so nothing earlier. Searched held texts citing 'Executive Order No. 2984' (cruden number EO:2984): only EO 4419. Searched T. 32 N., R. 76 W.: only 4419 and an 1884 GLO list. EO 4419 revokes with no deferred effective date; its date line reads 'A pril 17, 1926.' (OCR) in the same file. 4419 also restates the land and opens it 'subject to valid rights'.

first_end.mechanism: express revocation of the withdrawal it qualifies; the vested-rights proviso is a saving clause of that one withdrawal and has no separate end source (rights vested before revocation are not extinguished by it; 4419 itself opens the land 'subject to valid rights')
